findings.title: SQL injection
findings.detail: App-path text() uses bind params; ORM dominant. Scripts offline only.

findings.title: XSS
findings.detail: ReactMarkdown without rehype-raw; diagram SVG via data URI; no web CSP.

findings.title: CORS
findings.detail: Configured origins with credentials; methods/headers wildcard.

findings.title: Authentication
findings.detail: Argon2, cookies, refresh rotation, lockout, MFA API.

findings.title: Authorization
findings.detail: RBAC permissions; attempt ownership; some CMS paths permission-only.

findings.title: File uploads
findings.detail: PDF magic+size+path jail; CSV sandbox validators.

findings.title: SSRF
findings.detail: httpx to fixed provider URLs; no user-URL fetch found.

findings.title: Command injection
findings.detail: No shell=True in app/; OCR subprocess list-form.

findings.title: Secrets
findings.detail: .env gitignored; examples placeholders; prod vault UNVERIFIED.

findings.title: Rate limiting
findings.detail: Redis fixed window; auth fail-open vs recovery fail-closed.

findings.title: AI security
findings.detail: Factory safety gates; tutor relies on prompts+rate limits.

findings.title: Content trust
findings.detail: ECAEP prevents auto-publish of AI output.
